text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] S1 -> GPU OOM surge: 15 containers restarted in pool-evict-3 (us-west-2) in last 6m. Model: open-7b-v2 (quantized). Prefill path high memory (long context). Triggering stacktrace: `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` in `kernel_prefill.cu:432`.

maya (oncall): ack, paging SRE @sam, ml-runtime @hattie. collecting diagnostics. Is customer impact visible?

sam (sre): on it. grabbing jstack & pod logs. suspected noisy tenant with 80k token prefill.

hattie (ml-runtime): seeing large KV cache allocations in trace from pod id `pod-evict-3a`. Query sample: user session with 62k prompt.

sam (sre): logs snippet:
```
E CUDA: out of memory: tried to allocate 2.1GiB
E Trace: kernel_prefill.cu:432 cuCtxSynchronize -> CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS
Pod: pod-evict-3a container restart at 2024-06-15T17:12:03Z
```

maya (oncall): mitigation options: 1) patch runtime to cap prefill tokens to 16k 2) isolate noisy pod 3) force fallback to cpu-model-1 for that tenant 4) evict to hotpool. Which is fastest?

hattie (ml-runtime): fastest = runtime cap + per-tenant circuit-breaker. I can push a config flip to limit prefill to 8k (safe). Rolling change to configmap -> pods pick it up within ~90s.

sam (sre): I'll isolate the node and cordon it (node-uw2-gpu-21) to prevent wider flaps. Starting drain now.

kevin (cust-ops): customer ops: we're seeing ~9 customers with errors, biggest is BetaCorp - their chat sessions showing 502s and reconnect loops. Preparing a short message.

maya (oncall): do patch now. @hattie please flip to 8k cap + enable kv-cache trim on eviction. @sam start node cordon and move affected pods.

hattie (ml-runtime): flipping config: `prefill_max_tokens: 8192`, `kv_cache_trim: true` -> applying.

hattie (ml-runtime): config applied, rolling restart in progress. watch metrics: prefill_alloc_gb per-pod.

sam (sre): node cordoned + pods draining. Recreated pods on pool-evict-3b.

jordan (engineer): pushed temporary hotpatch to scheduler to reject requests with prefill > 20k at the gateway. rule id: gw-prefill-2024-06-15.

kevin (cust-ops): BetaCorp notified: "We saw intermittent errors, mitigation in progress, ETA 30m for stable". Sent to CSM.

maya (oncall): monitoring graphs: pod restarts dropped from 15/6m -> 1/10m. Latency for BetaCorp improving. still watching for CUDA errors.

sam (sre): ran `kubectl logs` on one restarted pod: no segfaults after change. kernel traces clear.

hattie (ml-runtime): KV cache footprint down ~65% on recreated pods. Looks effective.

maya (oncall): moving to triage -> S2. Create follow-up for runtime quotas and per-tenant throttles.

sam (sre): opening follow-up ticket INC-2024-345: "prefill memory hard limit & per-tenant circuit-breaker". Assigning to ml-runtime + sRE.

kevin (cust-ops): Customer update sent. BetaCorp acked and paused heavy long-context tests.

maya (oncall): handoff in 25m to jordan. @jordan please watch rollout and CPU fallback metrics. If restarts return, escalate.

jordan (engineer): ack, will monitor. setting alert `prefill_restart_rate` to 0.5/min threshold.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded -> S2. Automated follow-up ticket created: INC-2024-345. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem.

maya (oncall): thanks team. quick postmortem and log bundle request to follow. closing pager for now, keep thread for notes.

kevin (cust-ops): copying timeline into customer ticket. will coordinate postmortem comms.
